transport: UTF-8 JSON Lines over child-process stdin/stdout; diagnostics on stderr; no HTTP backend
renderer: contextBridge request/onEvent/importFiles only; no raw Node, IPC or filesystem APIs
fileAccess: Electron native dialogs and native drag File objects issue opaque tokens; renderer cannot submit arbitrary paths
storage: existing exports/<UID>.json plus accounts/metadata, transaction locks and original-preserving migration
appearance: color_mode light/dark; legacy orbit -> dark, sky/journal -> light; unknown settings retained
records: Python filtering/sorting/pagination; max 200 rows per request; five-star pool cards show up to 60 entries with paginated access to the rest
updates: separate stable/beta manifest, user confirms download, SHA256 verification, background/cancel/retry/later-install, revalidation on restart, helper waits for Electron and Python processes
development: isolated userData; no-sandbox only in automated review commands, never a production default
